task.description: Implement OIDC-F-06: dynamic OIDC config from hostname. (1) Create web/src/auth/tenantConfig.ts: exports async function fetchTenantConfig(hostname: string): Promise<{oidc_authority: string; client_id: string}>. Calls GET /api/tenant-config?host={hostname}, returns result or falls back to env vars on error. Caches result in module-level variable. (2) Refactor web/src/auth/OidcManager.ts: instead of creating UserManager at module load, export getOidcManager(): Promise<UserManager> that calls fetchTenantConfig first and lazy-inits (or re-inits) UserManager. Or: export a resolved promise. Keep the existing export oidcManager for backward compat if possible. (3) Update web/src/pages/OidcCallbackPage.tsx and LoginPage.tsx to use await getOidcManager() instead of the sync oidcManager import if needed. (4) npm run type-check, npm run lint, npm run build must exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: Fallback to env vars on API failure
